title: [Revise] C03 revision 1: answer the independent review in PR #77
body:
## Bounded author revision

Parent package: C03 (#44, closed), unit YM-000026, umbrella #26. Coordinator: @hairer. Source pin: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Base branch: `codex/existence-monograph`.

Respond to the independent agent review of C03 merged in PR #77 (`blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C03/review/`, outcome "changes requested"). The review found no false theorem, but listed required changes M1–M13 (`mathematics.md`) and L1–L12 (`lean.md`). Nobody has answered it: none of the affected chapters has changed since PR #69 (`6fa64da`), and #44 was closed with the review open.

Required changes, from the review's own list:
1. `limits.tex` 303–305: correct the sentence about the main construction (M1/L1).
2. `reflection-transport.tex`: correct the commutation paragraph (M2/L7); name the cutoff-covariance convergence input in the application (M7/L10).
3. `phase-quantitative-producer.tex`: add the missing hypotheses of `prop:ex-selected-interpolation` (M3/L8); state the specialisation f_i = i, C_i = C (M4/L5); supremum bound and station-block index in `prop:ex-public-origin` (M5/L6).
4. `fullmesh-fixedbounds-producer.tex`: budget quantifiers and a reference for the centring step (M6); order on the index set (M8); integer coordinates (M9b).
5. `fullmesh-correlation-cauchy.tex`: name the separation metric (M9a).
6. `phase-fields.tex` application paragraph (M10); `actual-slab-copy-bounds.tex` wording (M11).
7. `results/C03/` ledger, correspondence and findings: E4 split as in M12, edge identifiers and premises as in M13, wrong declaration names L2–L4/L7.
Recommended, not blocking: M14.

## Owned outputs

- The seven chapters named above, in `manuscript/existence/`, limited to the listed changes.
- `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C03/` (author files only; `review/` stays untouched).

No edits to the review files, other packages' chapters or ledgers (the C04 side of E4 goes in the report as a proposed patch), the main include, preamble, glossary, bibliography, the existing `*-evidence.md` files (corrections go in the report) or Lean.

## Readiness and acceptance

Ready: #44 has no live claim; its author (ADB991, run of 2026-11-12) and reviewer (schmittj) claims are released; the C03 chapters are unchanged since the reviewed head. Post and recheck a separate claim before work.

Acceptance: each required item answered by an edit or by a reply with evidence; blueprint checker and tests pass; the monograph builds and the changed pages are inspected; one focused draft PR against `codex/existence-monograph`; handoff and release here and a pointer on #26. New prose is draft and needs renewed independent review of the changed chapters (not by the author account). No merge or publication.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
